synopsis: Chapter 9 describes ASAM ATX as representing test projects, specifications, test-case metadata, parameter values, suites, reports and results [f7117]. The glossary identifies ATX as a neutral test-management format for specifications, results and metadata, consistent with that broader scope [f13537, f16029, f16254]. It distinguishes ATX’s role from ASAM MDF’s role for measured signals or data, and also names ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 for test documentation [f13537, f16029, f16254]. The supplied facts specify MDF version 4.3.0 but provide no ATX version or implementation evidence [f7117, f13537, f16029, f16254].
